provenance_and_association: Canonical common Git directory is local repository identity, not a remote/global repository ID. All note records retain requested ref, pinned ref tip, target commit and note blob. Paths/ranges apply to that target commit, not current worktree state.

No event timestamps are emitted. Commit/note timestamps are not tool execution times. Ordering is deterministic projection order, not conversation chronology. No turns, tool spans, duration, token totals or full transcripts are synthesized.
Native session key s_<14hex>, checkpoint key t_<14hex>, legacy 16/7-hex prompt key and h_<14hex> human key are preserved. Checkpoints are not OTel span IDs.

Declared agent tool/id/model are namespaced attributes under unisphere.git_ai.agent.*; agent.id is a source-declared conversation/session identifier, not a verified cross-adapter join. Join only with explicit namespace/provenance policy; no global entity association is performed here.

Valid missing identity-map entries produce identity_resolution=unresolved and retain key/range evidence; no cross-note/private-cache lookup. Declared identities without any attested lines are retained.

Human-author strings, custom attributes and legacy messages/URLs require MappingOptions.include_content. They appear once on identity records; URLs are inert. Null/missing counts remain unknown, not zeros.

One ref selected explicitly, no tracking-ref aggregation. The closing manifest replaces only the stated repository/ref/normalized selection after complete output acceptance. Pinning does not retain objects against Git GC; no persistent history or exactly-once semantics.
integration_boundary: Araminta owns plan014 source and registration changes until candidate handoff; Main coordinates convergence of shared app/CLI/SDK files with plan015. Tiger is read-only here and can model independent query lanes using these core ports/fakes. No existing broad query implementation is supplied.
next_action_boundary: Plan015 next-action/recovery requirement is noted, not silently added to plan014. GitNotesError exposes typed kind/message and wrapped PipelineError for output; current CLI diagnostics/summaries go to stderr, never OTLP stdout. Shared app routing is a named convergence boundary.

limitations: Observed Darwin/Unix synthetic fixtures, not every platform/dialect.
No network-denial trace; standard Git controls and promisor refusal exercised.
Negative-only ownership fixture forces standard Git ownership check; positive Git-AI-absent proof uses actual Git directly.
Caller-controlled output parents; concurrent malicious path replacement is not claimed safe.
